# `candid offer`

Record and compare offers.

## Usage

```
usage: python -m candid offer [-h] <subcommand> ...
```

## Subcommands

| Subcommand | Description |
|---|---|
| `add` | Record an offer. |
| `list` | List recorded offers. |
| `compare` | Compare offers side by side. |
| `export` | Export the offer comparison as markdown. |


### `candid offer add`

Record an offer.

```
usage: python -m candid offer add [-h] --company COMPANY --role ROLE [--level LEVEL] [--location LOCATION] [--base BASE] [--bonus-pct BONUS_TARGET_PCT] [--bonus-first BONUS_FIRST_YEAR_GUARANTEED] [--equity EQUITY_TOTAL] [--equity-type EQUITY_TYPE] [--vest-years VEST_YEARS] [--vest-schedule VEST_SCHEDULE] [--benefits BENEFITS_VALUE] [--sign-on SIGN_ON] [--start START_DATE] [--notes NOTES]
```

| Option | Description |
|---|---|
| `--company` `COMPANY` | (required) |
| `--role` `ROLE` | (required) |
| `--level` `LEVEL` | - |
| `--location` `LOCATION` | - |
| `--base` `BASE` | - |
| `--bonus-pct` `BONUS_TARGET_PCT` | - |
| `--bonus-first` `BONUS_FIRST_YEAR_GUARANTEED` | - |
| `--equity` `EQUITY_TOTAL` | - |
| `--equity-type` `EQUITY_TYPE` | (default: rsu) |
| `--vest-years` `VEST_YEARS` | (default: 4) |
| `--vest-schedule` `VEST_SCHEDULE` | - |
| `--benefits` `BENEFITS_VALUE` | - |
| `--sign-on` `SIGN_ON` | One-time sign-on bonus $ (amortized over 2 yrs in comparisons) |
| `--start` `START_DATE` | - |
| `--notes` `NOTES` | - |


### `candid offer list`

List recorded offers.

```
usage: python -m candid offer list [-h]
```

### `candid offer compare`

Compare offers side by side.

```
usage: python -m candid offer compare [-h]
```

### `candid offer export`

Export the offer comparison as markdown.

```
usage: python -m candid offer export [-h] [--out OUT]
```

| Option | Description |
|---|---|
| `--out` `OUT` | Output path (default: candid_data/offer_comparisons/<date>_offer_comparison.md) |
